findings.title: Batch list query is not filtered by BranchId
findings.impact: Branch users see batches of other branches in the same company.
findings.remediation: Same fix as the order lookup: filter by BranchId in RepositoryBaseManager.

findings.title: Static CustomConnectionString can leak a tenant database across concurrent requests
findings.evidence: public static string DbName { get; set; }
findings.impact: Under concurrent load a request can run against another tenant's database.
findings.remediation: Resolve the tenant connection string per request through a scoped service.
